remoteAccess.description: Connect a phone or tablet to this Pisper instance. The app prefers LAN and falls back to Iroh P2P away from home; TLS fingerprint pinning and device tokens still protect the upper layer.
remoteAccess.firewallDisabled: Remote access is off. Rules managed by Pisper have been cleaned up.
remoteAccess.firewallConfigured: Pisper firewall policy was configured at the last check.
remoteAccess.firewallNotNeeded: The system firewall was detected as inactive. No allow rule is needed.
remoteAccess.firewallNeedsAuthorization: An allow policy has not been confirmed. Retry locally and complete system authorization.
remoteAccess.firewallUnsupported: Automatic firewall configuration is unavailable in this environment.
remoteAccess.firewallCancelled: System authorization was cancelled. Access has not been confirmed.
remoteAccess.firewallCleanupPending: The remote listener has stopped, but firewall rules still need cleanup. Retry cleanup.
remoteAccess.firewallPackagedApp: macOS requires the packaged Pisper app to authorize its dedicated sidecar. Generic Node.js processes are never allowed.
remoteAccess.firewallUnsupportedBackend: No supported system firewall tool is available. Linux automation supports UFW and an active firewalld.
remoteAccess.firewallPermissionDenied: System permission was not granted. Policy enforcement has not been confirmed.
remoteAccess.firewallTimeout: System authorization or the operation timed out. It may still be running; retry the check later.
remoteAccess.firewallBlockAll: macOS is set to block all incoming connections. Pisper does not change this global setting.
remoteAccess.firewallRuleChanged: The HTTPS port, runtime path, or network zone has changed. Existing rules need updating.
remoteAccess.firewallVerificationFailed: System policy could not be verified. Retry and check system permissions or organization policies.
remoteAccess.firewallWorking: Checking or waiting for system authorization…
remoteAccess.firewallApplicationScope: macOS authorizes applications: only the packaged Pisper sidecar is allowed to receive connections. This system policy cannot be limited to one port.
remoteAccess.firewallProgramPortScope: Windows allows only this runtime program on HTTPS TCP port {port}, from LocalSubnet sources including LAN IPv4/IPv6. No additional Tailscale address range is allowed.
remoteAccess.firewallPortScope: Linux allows only remote HTTPS TCP port {port}. The global firewall switch is unchanged.
remoteAccess.firewallReachability: A local listener or configured rule does not prove the phone can connect. LAN reachability is unverified and still depends on network isolation, other firewalls, and phone permissions.
remoteAccess.loadFailed: Failed to load remote access status. Make sure the runtime supports remote access.
